title: Zombie in the Gallery
description: A dimly lit art gallery room with a large wooden desk in the foreground holding a lit lamp, coffee cup, vintage radio, and keys. Rain falls through a broken skylight. A massive painting on the wall depicts a bloody zombie walking down a horror hallway, while a person in the right foreground holds a bloody fire axe.
prompt: Interior of a dark art gallery at night with rain pouring through a broken glass skylight. A large wooden desk sits in the foreground with a glowing desk lamp, coffee cup, old radio, and keys. On the back wall hangs a giant surreal painting showing a bloody zombie walking down a horror hallway with red exit signs. A person holds a bloody fire axe on the right side of the frame. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
